subject: planner: use prop based noCopPushDown mechanism to replace aggregation field. (#62249)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in planner. It removes the global/mutating `disableAggPushDownToCop()` (which walked Apply’s outer subtree setting `LogicalAggregation.NoCopPushDown=true`) and replaces it with a `PhysicalProperty.NoCopPushDown` flag that is (1) set on Apply’s outer child required prop, (2) plumbed through key child-prop construction sites, and (3) included in `PhysicalProperty.HashCode()` and `CloneEssentialFields()` to avoid memoization collisions. No remaining plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency issues found in the touched planner paths.
